open_questions: symbols.json has 0x08084bb2 as Scr_ReleaseAnyValue (void) and 0x08084d24 as Scr_ReleaseLocalizedString (void). The binary returns a script string (both call ScrStr_TextFromHandle; 0x08084bb2 calls Scr_GetAny). Chunk 104 uses fn_08084bb2/fn_08084d24 placeholders with const char * results; the merge lane should correct the merged signatures.

Several hud-field wrappers (0x081038ea..0x08103af4) pass record indices and names arrays through HudElem_SetEnumField (0x081034de, merged). The alternate dispatcher 0x08103618 is out of chunk and its name is a placeholder; its signature is assumed identical to HudElem_SetEnumField.
Trace layout (fraction, normal, surface flags, entity, startsolid) is inferred from stack offsets in 0x0810a528 callers, not from the callee body; confirm when 0x0810a528 is reconstructed.

GScr_setcvar: the quote-normalised copy is written but the raw value is passed to Dvar_SetStringOrCreate (preserved). The original loop bound (0x2000 characters) exceeds the 0x400-byte buffer; this translation bounds the copy at 0x3ff, which removes a stack overflow the binary has.
Gclient offsets 0xe8, 0xec, 0x10c..0x118, 0x590, 0x594 and 0x2740 are read from pseudocode only; not yet confirmed against the disassembly of every user.

Naming: 67 functions are inferred from the script method table at .rodata (name pointer at fn-4); only the five setTimerUp-family and FinishSpawningItem carry literal evidence in their own bodies. Turret_*, Entity_*, Debug_*, Aim_* and Cmd_ParseConfigstring12Bounds_f are descriptive (unknown).

Turret_Setup, Turret_Occupy and Turret_FindAimOffset depend on unmerged helpers (0x0811f3c6, 0x081022a0, 0x0810ccf2, 0x08105cac) whose semantics are not yet known; their fn_ placeholders keep the observed argument shapes.
FinishSpawningItem: the item type checks use itemIndex (0x1ac) for the start-solid branch and kindIndex (0x8c) for the roll adjustment, as in the binary.
